main_text.l: AMPLISSIMIS VIRIS NICOLAO A GRAVEN-RIET GERMANICAE, ET HIERONYMO MANUELI SABAUDICAE DITIONIS, IN INCLYTA BERNENSIUM REPUBLICA QUAESTORIBUS & SCHOLARCHIS, DOMINIS MEIS COLENDISSIMIS, IOANNES HALLERUS S. D.

CUM ante annos prope sedecim, inter caetera veterum monumenta peruestigata, in farragine quoq; Gratiani, quam librum Decretorum vocant, incidissem, eamq; perlustrarem, quam ille ex Veterum conciliorum Decretis, scriptisq; & dictis patrum collegit, & in unum corpus sua quadam methodo compositam, redegit, inveni multa, quae mihi cum veteri Apostolica & syncériore doctrina convenire, & cum multis, quae hodie ecclesiae tanquam Catholica & orthodoxa obtrudũtur, imo sub nomine ecclesiae aguntur, usurpantur & venditantur, plurimum disconvenientiae habere deprehendebantur. Confirmatum ergo ex lectione horum

page.notes: The dedication title is set in mixed type sizes and spacing; the hyphenated line breaks (GRAVEN-RIET, HIE-RONYMO, IN-CLYTA, COLENDISSI-MIS, HAL-LERUS) are joined as whole words. The page number at the top right is a small mark that may be a "3" or a printer's sign; marked [?]. A faint ghosted line above the title is show-through and was left out. The initial "C" is a decorated woodcut letter joined to "UM". The word "Manueli" has a mark over the i that is unclear; kept as printed. The abbreviation "S. D." is printed with a mark over the D. The tilde in "obtrudũtur" is read as printed over the u.
